# LightweightNeuromorphic

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
A neuromorphic computing approach that minimizes resource usage (parameters, memory, energy) while preserving functional accuracy. It enables embedding of neuromorphic processing into resource-constrained network nodes within TCC architectures.
